props.gloss_en: the mishna: [a gentile's slaughter is a neveila] and imparts impurity by carrying

Rava (version 1): this is what it teaches -- this one imparts impurity by carrying, and you have another that imparts impurity even in a tent: an idolatrous offering; and [it is] like R' Yehuda ben Beteira
an idolatrous offering imparts impurity in a tent

Rava (version 2): this is what it teaches -- this one imparts impurity by carrying, and you have another like it that imparts impurity by carrying and does not impart impurity in a tent: an idolatrous offering; and [it is] not like R' Yehuda ben Beteira
an idolatrous offering imparts impurity by carrying
and [an idolatrous offering] does not impart impurity in a tent
